canonical_title: Stall protection in wing level and turning flight

versions.title_at_revision: Stall protection in wing level and turning flight
versions.text:
(a) Flight tests shall be conducted in straight flight and in the maximum bank angle allowed by the flight control protection features for each relevant UAV flaps configuration for the most unfavourable combination of weight, centre of gravity and engine setting while abruptly reducing speed command as per relevant flight control mode.
(b) During these tests, it should be shown that
  (1) the steady speed achieved should remain greater than or equal to the minimum steady flight speed (except take-off and landing) allowed by the flight envelope protection maintained by the flight control system.
  (2) No unsafe characteristics occur.
